result.title: Service-owned canvas history and immutable diagram persistence
result.description: Implement the reviewed architecture proposal at a082bbed: replace the canvas overview, clarify revision payloads and coordinated editing, add service/history, proposal lifecycle and durable-record details, and annotate paired ownership migrations. Originals remain untouched.

changes.title: Replace page hierarchy to separate injected services, canonical contexts and materialized reads
Reconnect unchanged GridBox detail to the replacement overview
Extend Diagram with immutable revision ownership and detached logical-node reads
Reconnect unchanged FloatingBox detail to the replacement overview
Unify controller updates and agent routes; delegate history ownership (M1 source)
Add DiagramService contexts and coordinated history (M1 destination)
Add ChangeSession capture, history forks, durable navigation and isolated previews
Split canvas catalog ownership from diagram storage; retain compatibility facade (M2 source)

migrations.title: Controller history becomes service-owned coordinated history
migrations.description: Feature ownership moves from controller-local document/canvas undo state to CanvasHistory behind injected DiagramService. Controller undo/redo/reset remain delegation adapters.

migrations.title: CanvasCatalogStore takes over catalog publication
migrations.description: Catalog save/projection/archive and serialized publication now belong to CanvasCatalogStore. ProjectCatalogStore is a compatibility subclass retaining compaction APIs; generic catalogPersistence helpers are only a code-organization extraction.
